verdict.rationale: Phoenix's docs extensively document capturing OTLP/OpenTelemetry-based traces of LLM calls, including inputs/outputs (span data), application latency, and detailed token usage breakdowns, plus auto-instrumentation for popular frameworks and manual tracing decorators.
